stem: Which sentence from “The Cure for Concrete” shows a **similar** outcome for bioconcrete?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 5 of “Persevering Plants.”

Rodriguez has tested his endophyte mixture on crops and achieved success.

options.label: F
options.text: The bacteria can live in the hardened concrete for decades. (paragraph 5)

options.label: G
options.text: In 2011 self-healing concrete was used to construct a lifeguard station near a lake in the Netherlands. (paragraph 6)

options.label: H
options.text: With the help of Jonkers’ bioconcrete, the lifeguard station has remained intact. (paragraph 6)

options.label: J
options.text: Bioconcrete has been used on the floors and roofs of parking garages. (paragraph 6)

visual_elements: Rodriguez has tested his endophyte mixture on crops and achieved success.
